title: Dynamics of the Currency Composition of Central Bank Reserves
abstract: arXiv:2608.24468v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We examine how macroeconomic and geopolitical developments in the United States, the euro area, and China affect the currency composition of central banks' foreign exchange reserves. Using an unbalanced panel of reserve shares for 53 countries over 1999-2023, we estimate a constrained system of equations that explicitly imposes the adding-up restriction on reserve shares. The results indicate substantial persistence in reserve holdings and significant cross-currency dependence, supporting a system-wide dynamics of reserve composition. In the country fixed-effects specification (1) issuer economic size, (2) uncertainty, (3) sanctions, (4) trade linkages, and (5) issuer credibility are significantly associated with reserve allocation across currencies. With the inclusion of year fixed effects, the persistence and cross-currency dependence remain, while trade linkages and sanctions emerge as the most important determinants of reserve compos

translated_title: 中央银行储备货币构成的动态变化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了美国、欧元区和中国的宏观经济及地缘政治发展如何影响中央银行外汇储备的货币构成。利用1999年至2023年间53个国家储备份额的非平衡面板数据，我们估计了一个受约束的方程组系统，明确地对储备份额施加了加总限制。结果表明，储备持有存在显著的持续性，且货币间存在明显的相互依赖关系，支持了储备构成的系统级动态。在国家固定效应模型中，(1) 发行国经济规模、(2) 不确定性、(3) 制裁、(4) 贸易联系和 (5) 发行国信誉与跨货币的储备配置显著相关。在纳入年份固定效应后，持续性和货币间依赖仍然存在，而贸易联系和制裁成为储备构成的最重要决定因素。
tldr: 本研究通过约束方程组模型，发现贸易联系和制裁是决定中央银行储备货币构成的最重要因素，且储备持有具有显著持续性和货币间相互依赖。
en_tdlr: This study, using a constrained equation system, finds that trade linkages and sanctions are the most important determinants of central bank reserve currency composition, with significant persistence and cross-currency dependence.
